name: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level)
summary: National-level exam for recruitment to Group B and Group C posts in central government ministries and departments.
eligibility: Indian citizen (or Nepal/Bhutan subject, or Tibetan refugee who arrived before January 1962)
Bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognised university (final-year students can apply provisionally)
Age 18-32 years as of 1 August of the exam year, with upper-age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen
documents: Recent photograph and signature (digital, per SSC specification)
Valid photo ID for exam day
fee: ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS male candidates; women, SC, ST, PwBD, and eligible Ex-Servicemen are exempt.
process: Register and apply online via the SSC portal, paying the fee by UPI/net banking/card
Qualified candidates appear for Tier 2 (descriptive/skill test depending on post)
Final merit list and post allocation released

faq.question: What's the age limit for SSC CGL?
faq.answer: 18-32 years as of 1 August of the exam year for most posts, with relaxation of 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST candidates, and further relaxation for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Do women have to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No — women, SC, ST, PwBD, and eligible Ex-Servicemen candidates are fully exempt from the ₹100 application fee.
